name: Jumin Shin
tagline: I translate user needs into working digital experiences.
bio: I'm a UX Design Engineer based in Los Angeles. I connect user research, interaction design, prototyping and front-end implementation to shape digital experiences, from AI-assisted creative tools to spatial interfaces and healthcare workflows.

I study Integrated Design, Business and Technology at USC's Iovine and Young Academy, following a double degree in Design Convergence and Game Software at Hongik University. That background brings design, research, and implementation into the same practice.

My experience includes an AI production platform at Bubba's LA, mixed-method UX research at Macromill Embrain, and USC industry collaborations with American Honda, Johnson & Johnson MedTech, and ARS Pharma. I have also co-authored research on interactive storytelling, music expression, and electric-vehicle charging interfaces.
